description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and inline functions for managing chunks of data, including files, memory, strings, and buffers, used in the lighttpd web server. It handles chunk queues, chunk files, and iteration over chunks.

classes.name: liChunkFile
classes.description: Represents a file used in chunks, tracking reference count, filename, file descriptor, and temporary status.

classes.name: liChunk
classes.description: Represents a chunk of data which can be of various types such as string, memory, file, or buffer.

classes.name: liCQLimit
classes.description: Represents a limit on chunk data transfer, with callback notification and watcher.

classes.name: liChunkQueue
classes.description: A queue of chunks, managing data flow, limits, and state.

classes.name: liChunkIter
classes.description: Iterator for traversing chunks in a chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunk_error_quark
methods.description: Returns the GQuark for chunk error domain.

methods.name: li_chunkfile_new
methods.description: Creates a new liChunkFile object.

methods.name: li_chunkfile_acquire
methods.description: Increases reference count of a liChunkFile.

methods.name: li_chunkfile_release
methods.description: Decreases reference count and releases a liChunkFile.

methods.name: li_chunkfile_open
methods.description: Opens the file associated with a liChunkFile for reading.

methods.name: li_cqlimit_new
methods.description: Creates a new cqlimit object.

methods.name: li_cqlimit_reset
methods.description: Resets the cqlimit object.

methods.name: li_cqlimit_acquire
methods.description: Increases reference count of cqlimit.

methods.name: li_cqlimit_release
methods.description: Decreases reference count of cqlimit.

methods.name: li_cqlimit_set_limit
methods.description: Sets the data transfer limit for cqlimit.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_new
methods.description: Creates a new chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_reset
methods.description: Resets the chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_free
methods.description: Frees the chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_use_limit
methods.description: Applies a limit to the chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_set_limit
methods.description: Sets a limit object for the chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_limit_available
methods.description: Returns available space in the chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_string
methods.description: Appends a string as a chunk to the queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_bytearr
methods.description: Appends a byte array as a chunk.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_buffer
methods.description: Appends a buffer as a chunk.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_buffer2
methods.description: Appends a portion of a buffer as a chunk.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_mem
methods.description: Copies memory into the chunk queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_chunkfile
methods.description: Appends a chunk from a file object.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_file
methods.description: Appends a file by filename.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_file_fd
methods.description: Appends a file using an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_tempfile
methods.description: Appends a temporary file.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_append_tempfile_fd
methods.description: Appends a temporary file using an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_steal_len
methods.description: Transfers up to a specified length of data from one queue to another.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_steal_all
methods.description: Transfers all chunks from one queue to another.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_steal_chunk
methods.description: Transfers the first chunk from one queue to another.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes in the queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_skip_all
methods.description: Skips all data in the queue.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_extract_to
methods.description: Extracts data from the queue into a GString.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_extract_to_memory
methods.description: Extracts data into a memory buffer.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_extract_to_bytearr
methods.description: Extracts data into a byte array.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_get_last_buffer
methods.description: Returns the last buffer in the queue if suitable.

methods.name: li_chunkqueue_update_last_buffer_size
methods.description: Updates the size of the last buffer in the queue.
